run.extractorKind: rule-based stand-in for the LLM pipeline

settings.directRule: AI marker AND harm marker AND >=1 causal element within one sentence
settings.inferredRule: AI marker and (harm marker AND causal element) in different sentences
settings.completenessRule: >=3 named pathway stages in the passage counts as complete
settings.duplicateRule: Jaccard >= 0.6 over content tokens of the passage

deviations: Extraction ran on titles and abstracts, not full texts, because that is the text the arXiv and OpenAlex APIs return. Passages are therefore short and completeness is systematically understated.

A deterministic ruleset stands in for the LLM. Direct/inferred labels follow a syntactic rule, where an LLM would follow a semantic judgement. Expect the LLM to find more inferred scenarios than this extractor does.

12 hand-read sources were not extracted. Only the reviewer's own note is stored for them, and emitting that as a passage would present paraphrase as quotation. They carry a reviewer scenario estimate instead, totalling 46.
